fields.System.Title: RET-301 — Record an inspection outcome
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a quality inspector, I want to record what I found when I examined a return, so that
the disposition decision is based on evidence.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a quarantined return line, then I record a condition grade — not a yes/no.
  • - Given any grade other than "as new", then a reason is mandatory.
  • - Given the inspection, then the product identity is verified by scan — customers do
  • return the wrong item.
  • - Given an expiry-tracked product, then the expiry date is re-captured from the physical
  • goods.
  • - Given a quantity, then it can be split across grades — five as new, three damaged.
  • - Given the inspection, then returns.inspection_completed is published.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|

| Tables | inspection |
| Risks | Rubber-stamped inspection ([doc 09 §8.2](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); wrong product not detected ([doc 05 WF 9](../../../docs/05-workflows.md)) |
